content: सगोत्र {%a.%} Being of the same family or kin, related. .{@-त्रः@} .²1 A kinsman sprung from a common ancestor; तत्रभवतो युष्मत्सगोत्रस्य कण्वस्यापराद्धोऽस्मि <ls>Ś. 7</ls>. .²2 A kinsman of the same family, one connected by funeral oblations of food and water. .²3 A distant kinsman. .{@-तम्@} Family, race, lineage.
